scope: Improve readability and touch targets for nearby voice, camera, and screen sharing while keeping presenter/event tools opt-in.

productDefaults.nearbyChat: Available from the world with Enter.
productDefaults.microphoneCameraScreenShare: Core communication controls remain available by default.
productDefaults.presenterAndEventTools: Hidden by default; visible only after the user explicitly enables supplemental event tools in Settings. Attendance remains disabled by default.

changes: Increased media call status, camera captions, screen-share headings, and mobile media control labels.
Expanded camera pin and floating-panel resize touch targets.
Kept camera and screen-share panels movable and resizable, with independent shared-screen audio volume.

desktopCoreMedia.test: real SFU carries microphone, camera and shared-screen RTP, then revokes distant receivers and cleans up on leave
assertions: Microphone, camera, and shared-screen RTP flowed through the local SFU.
Call status, camera heading, and pin touch target met the updated minimum sizes.
Screen-share panel drag and resize continued to work.

mobileAndDesktopCoreMedia.test: mobile and desktop participants exchange microphone and camera RTP over the SFU
assertions: Microphone and camera RTP flowed through the local SFU.
Mobile call status, control labels, and camera captions met the updated font-size minimums.

validation.frontendProductionBuild: PASS; existing Phaser chunk-size warning remains.
validation.prettier: PASS for the updated styles and media E2E test.
validation.runtime: Used the existing shared local SFU without restarting it; no production deployment.

limitations: Physical iOS and Android layouts and touch interaction were not tested.
Shared Media and Prometheus runtimes still need a coordinated local activation to expose the new media metrics; no restart or reload was performed.
